query: Which launched first, the Aurora X1 or the Vega S2?

documents.text: The Aurora X1 launched in March 2024.
The Vega S2 launched in November 2024.
Rumor: the Vega S2 was expected to launch in January 2024, but it slipped to November.

expected: The rumor doc mentions January 2024; it must not be treated as a launch date.
